pulse.currentFocus: Session 330 completed the attention-safe experience arc: one shared automatic-surface budget across public and member journeys, returning context moved inline, mobile footer/tap-target fixes, and final-tree evidence ordering. Exact staging passed build:check 370/370, mobile 235/235, visual 42/42, attention 15/15 cross-browser, and ceremony 8/8. Commits are on main; production remains on the older bundle because the mandatory real-provider identity gate is unresolved.
pulse.nextMilestone: Complete Obelisk relying-party registration and the founder passkey ceremony, regenerate identity/release proof, promote the exact full candidate to Pages and Worker production, then require the live new/returning visitor attention suite to pass 15/15.
blockers: production attention-safe release: the exact staging candidate passes 15/15, but production remains on the old bundle (3/15) because check-production-promotion-gate rejects real-provider-e2e-pending. obelisk.identity.verify is missing OBELISK_RP_ID, OBELISK_RP_NAME, and OBELISK_RP_ORIGIN; obelisk-staging-registration is also missing.

content promotion still depends on a route-provenance probe run from an unchallenged vantage for the PRODUCTION half of the receipt: CI is bot-challenged at the production origin and cannot produce the live route evidence the split-release guard requires. (A CI-reachable build-attestation vantage was added session 322 but deliberately cannot satisfy this gate.)

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

now: [S330][UX/P0] Coordinate every automatic notification through one visitor-attention budget. ✅ Shared `VSAttention` claim covers consent, PWA install, exit intent, visit depth, returning digest, journey tour/feedback, and portal notices. Consent/onboarding reserve functional priority; returning visitors receive at most one automatic surface per tab; 30-day cooldowns prevent repeat nags. Contract 15/15; exact staging behavior 15/15 across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

[S330][MOBILE/P1] Repair narrow-screen footer dispatch containment and the membership interview skip target. ✅ Footer collapses safely at ≤430px; the interview skip affordance is an inline-flex 44px target and its dynamic source is bound into the 235-cell mobile receipt.
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
